capabilities: Manage annotations in a right-side panel.
disambiguation: It stores annotations in sidecar JSON files, ensuring the original Markdown source files remain unmodified.
extras: Desktop only. Markdown notes only. No mobile support. No cloud sync or multi-user collaboration.
intentEvidence: Side comments and visual marks for Markdown notes, stored outside the note body.
problem: Users need a way to add reading annotations and visual marks to Markdown notes without altering the original source content.
summary: A desktop plugin that allows users to add visual marks and side comments to Markdown notes without modifying the original source text.
